data.name: Golf 5 eClub
data.detailed_description:
Developed in partnership with The R&A, DP World Tour, and Me and My Golf, Golf 5 will take your swing to new heights.

Whether you want to have a great time playing with friends, improve your shots as a golf beginner, or analyze your swing down to the millimeter like a pro, fun is guaranteed in Golf 5! Thanks to the High Precision Control (HPC©) physics engine and spectacular HD environments, you will forget you are in your living room.

**************

Compatible VR Devices: Meta Quest (original, 2, 3, 3S, Pro), Valve Index VR, PICO 4, 4 Ultra, HTC Vive Cosmos.

**************

⛳3 exclusive courses included: Dunes, Forest, and Tropical (with 3 pin positions). The last 3 holes of Jumeirah Golf Estates are also available in selected tournaments. Plus, get the Safari course for free simply by registering your game.

🏛️ 4 real courses (with 3 pin positions) via DLC. ● Old Course - St Andrews: the home of golf. ● Royal County Down: considered a design masterpiece. ● Sunningdale: a jewel of British golf. ● Valderrama: the premier course of continental Europe.

🏆 DLC Bundle: The Open Zone. The most iconic venues of The Open (with 3 pin positions). ● Royal Liverpool: a classic seaside links. ● Royal Troon: featuring its fearsome 8th hole, the "Postage Stamp". ● Royal Portrush: a spectacular Northern Irish layout surrounded by dunes. ● Royal Birkdale: the latest addition, a legendary course where true champions are crowned.

And more courses in development!

Game Modes:

🏌🏼 Classic Golf: practice on any course and hole. 9 or 18-hole rounds or Fast 3, solo or against the AI. Individual or team online matches (Scramble or Fourball). All available with Match Play, Stroke Play, or Stableford scoring systems.

🔝Driving Range perfect for warming up or competing.

🚩Putting Green to practice your short game.

⏱️WiPp: an exclusive, fast-paced game mode for instant fun.

🎯Minigolf: for a fun and relaxing time.

Features & Extras:

🥇Compete in tournaments to climb the International eGolf Federation (IEGF) rankings and become a Master.

🪙Earn G5 coins to buy additional in-game content: courses, clubs...

📈XTi©: professional Pro Launch Monitor to analyze your swing progress.

🦯Compatible with all VR golf club accessories. 🛒2 free Callaway club sets and 5 club sets available for purchase. 🛩Drone view.

🍃Wind simulation.

🌍Multilingual, including English.

👥3D Avatar, multi-user system, mobile companion app...

data.short_description: Take your swing to another dimension with Golf 5! Compete on hyper-realistic HD courses, enjoy solo and team modes, and play in official tournaments. Analyze your shots with professional technology, play online with friends, and much more!
data.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*, French*, German*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support
